node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-256 exclusion
node.closure: exact product ledger, dual radius census, and dual exact norms
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 256 is impossible. Exact product certification leaves 45 (E,q,L) chambers through E=20; dual complete radius engines find 54 signed vectors on 5920 multiplicity-eight affine orbits, and FLINT/PARI place every quotient Norm/256 below the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: hash-bucket and sorted-bucket engines agree on 23111680 third-position queries, 2833260 candidate heavy triples, 22666080 exact sign tests, and 54 product-live vectors. Six profile-(3,6) cofactors remain.
